question: According to census 2001, sex ratio is ______ females per 1000 males.
solution:
The correct answer is __**933.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to census 2001, sex ratio is **933 females per 1000 males.**
 
• The sex ratio is used to describe the **number of females per 1000 males.**
 
• Sex ratio is a valuable source for finding the population of women in India and what is the ratio of women to that men in India.
 
• In the **Population Census of 2011**, it was revealed that the population ratio in India in 2011 is 943, little higher than 2001.
 
• The Sex Ratio 2011 shows an upward trend from the census 2001 data.
 
• Census 2001 revealed that there were** 933 females to that 1000 males.**
 
• For decades India has seen a decrease in the sex ratio in 2011, but in the last two decades, there has been a slight increase in the sex ratio.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Census 2011**

 
 
• The Indian Census is the most credible source of information on Demography (Population characteristics), Economic Activity, Literacy and Education, Housing Household Amenities, Urbanization, Fertility and Mortality, etc. 
 
• Census 2011 was the **15th National Census of the Country.**
 
• Census was introduced in India during the era of Lord Mayo in the year **1872**.
 
• It came into force in **1881**.
 
• This census was conducted under the guidance of Mr. **C. Chandramouli**.
 
• The slogan of census 2011 was ‘**Our Census, Our future**’.
